required_future_evidence: Hematology/ED indication and ICH pathway review
versioned synthetic input fixtures and outputs
QA and release reviewer with exact commit SHA

cases.scenario: INR elevated but no major bleed, critical bleed or urgent invasive procedure
cases.expected_behavior: Reject PCC order; route to VKA adjustment/vitamin K assessment as appropriate

cases.scenario: DOAC apixaban/rivaroxaban/dabigatran/edoxaban selected
cases.expected_behavior: Reject VKA-specific dose; route to exact anticoagulant contract

cases.scenario: Anticoagulant identity unknown or only warfarin guessed
cases.expected_behavior: Reject drug-specific order; expert assessment of agent and last intake

cases.scenario: No INR for a manufacturer INR-stratified recipe
cases.expected_behavior: Do not calculate an INR-bracket PCC dose; urgent clinical management outside software remains possible

cases.scenario: INR 1.3–1.9 input to manufacturer table for INR >=2
cases.expected_behavior: Reject source mismatch; direct ICH to separately reviewed expert pathway

cases.scenario: Exact INR boundaries 3.9, 3.95, 4.0, 6.0 and >6.0
cases.expected_behavior: Use only manufacturer-supported INR intervals: Beriplex 2.0–3.9, 4.0–6.0, >6.0; Octaplex 2.0 to <4.0, 4.0–6.0, >6.0. Do NOT guess that Beriplex 3.95 belongs to a listed band without validated INR reporting/rounding rule; never overlap or extrapolate.

cases.scenario: Weight missing, zero, negative, boolean, NaN, infinity or impossible
cases.expected_behavior: Reject math; no default weight or fake adult estimate

cases.scenario: Weight >100 kg entered
cases.expected_behavior: Manufacturer general table must use approved 100 kg cap and single-dose maxima; no weight extrapolation

cases.scenario: Prescriber input in mL, mmol or insulin IU instead of factor-IX IU
cases.expected_behavior: Reject dimensional mismatch; show product-independent units for review

cases.scenario: Beriplex selected with Octaplex device, stability or dilution instructions
cases.expected_behavior: Reject cross-brand recipe and demand exact product authorization

cases.scenario: PCC actual brand/SKU/lot or RCM Portuguese not confirmed
cases.expected_behavior: Reject executable prescription/volume/rate

cases.scenario: Documented history of heparin-induced thrombocytopenia or relevant allergy
cases.expected_behavior: Block heparin-containing product pathway; urgent hematology alternative

cases.scenario: Known IgA deficiency with anti-IgA antibodies and Octaplex selected
cases.expected_behavior: Reject Octaplex under its current UK SmPC contraindication; independent product review

cases.scenario: Prothrombotic history not evaluated
cases.expected_behavior: No automated PCC order; clinical risk-benefit review and thrombosis monitoring

cases.scenario: Automatic 10mg IV vitamin K for minor bleed or isolated INR
cases.expected_behavior: Reject universal vitamin-K order; indication-specific regimen only

cases.scenario: Vitamin K product/route/diluent missing or assumed equivalent
cases.expected_behavior: Reject preparation and IV order; use exact local SmPC

cases.scenario: Use HIC INR1.3–1.9 expert 10IU/kg rule in non-ICH or routine manufacturer pathway
cases.expected_behavior: Reject protocol/indication mismatch; specialist decision required

cases.scenario: Non-supplied solvent, extra saline dilution or inappropriate mixing with another injection
cases.expected_behavior: Reject preparation; only product-specific reconstitution and IV route

cases.scenario: Apply 24h Beriplex physical stability to Octaplex, or to microbiological use-after-reconstitution
cases.expected_behavior: Reject assumed expiry; pharmacy-approved product-specific expiry

cases.scenario: Rate selected above product-specific maximum or without verified patient weight/label
cases.expected_behavior: Reject infusion programming; no implicit mL/min

cases.scenario: Second PCC dose generated automatically due to persistently abnormal INR alone
cases.expected_behavior: Reject automatic redosing; require hematology specialist and bleeding reassessment

cases.scenario: Attempt to set runtime_enabled or GREEN or export dose while BLOCKED/CLINICALLY_PENDING
cases.expected_behavior: Reject release and patient-specific order; preserve other 18 blocked contracts and all P1
